recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, painterly portrait blending 18th-century Napoleonic military aesthetics with modern urban streetwear elements. The subject is depicted in a three-quarter view against a dark, heavily textured sepia background, wearing a velvet officer's coat with ornate gold bullion embroidery and epaulettes, contrasted by a contemporary silk headwrap.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between historical military regalia and modern streetwear accessories
Chiaroscuro lighting highlighting the face and gold embroidery against deep shadows
Textural harmony between the cracked oil paint effect and the velvet fabric
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of authority and stature
coreInvariants: Muted earth-tone palette dominated by burnt umber and gold
Integration of modern facial markings or tattoos with classical lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, three-quarter profile, waist-up framing, occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white cravat and gold-embroidered lapel at the center-top of the torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the illuminated face, follows the gold embroidery down the arm to the hands, then circles back through the textured background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark atmospheric space surrounding the subject to emphasize isolation and importance.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the metallic and fabric highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Low legibility, blending into the background texture
Distressed edges to match the painting's age
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are rendered with low opacity to appear as if embossed or faded into the canvas
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative face paired with minimal, modern sans-serif metadata in corners.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory label in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the historical, regal tone of the military uniform.
Provides the necessary ornate, dark aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital oil painting of a man in a black velvet 18th-century military coat with gold embroidery and a black silk durag. Use chiaroscuro lighting and a cracked, dark sepia canvas texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a weathered Gothic-style title in the bottom right corner using a dark bronze color that blends into the background texture. Add a standard parental advisory sticker in the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistent across the subject and background?
Does the gold embroidery have a metallic sheen?
Is the lighting dramatic and moody?
Is the modern headwear clearly visible but stylistically integrated?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the cracked paint texture
Level of detail in the gold embroidery
mustRedesign: Any modern logos or specific brand identifiers
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of modern and classical elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 'cracked' texture doesn't obscure the subject's face too much.
Verify the gold trim looks like physical thread, not just a yellow line.
Check that the cravat provides the necessary focal point highlight.
Confirm the background feels atmospheric and deep rather than flat.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Historical Era Costume] with [Modern Subculture Accessory] + [Chiaroscuro Lighting] + [Cracked Oil Canvas Texture] + [Muted Earth Tones].
